content:
incident-bot: PAGER: region=us-nw severity=sev2 — Elevated 5xx rate observed at gateway-us-nw. Alert: 5xx rate = 4.8% (threshold 3%). Last 5m spike. Pager: @alex.chen @maya.patel. Dashboard: https://redwood.internal/alerts/2149005000 :rotating_light:

alex.chen: taking this — looking at gateway and upstream RTs now. seeing lots of 502/504s clustered around lb-*-us-nw.

maya.patel: i'm oncall, taking ownership. any recent deploys to us-nw?

devops-bot: deploy-bot: No production deploys to gateway-us-nw in the last 30m.

rick.oneill: raw error logs — a few thousand conn reset + upstream timeouts. suspect backlog on backend tier (model-proxy) or intermittent redis auth throttling. sample:

```

2026-03-15T18:24:12Z gateway-us-nw ERROR request_id=abcd1234 upstream=proxy-12 502 upstream-read-timeout
2026-03-15T18:24:13Z gateway-us-nw WARN request_id=abcd1299 conn_reset by peer
2026-03-15T18:24:14Z gateway-us-nw ERROR request_id=abcd1301 upstream=proxy-08 504 gateway-timeout

```

alex.chen: can reproduce with k6 quick run hitting the same route, 95th latency spiking before 5xx. sending tail -f logs now.

ops-analytics: we see ~0.9% of GA customers experienced errors, but certain high-throughput clients in APAC->US flow account for ~60% of the 5xx traffic (long-lived requests).

maya.patel: plan: 1) short-term: steer traffic away from us-nw to us-west for affected route (traffic-controller) 2) scale model-proxy in us-nw + bump connection pool 3) identify offending client(s) and rate-limit if necessary. Starting step 1 now.

alex.chen: prepping traffic-controller command. suggested weight shift: us-nw=0.15 -> us-west=0.85 over 3 minutes.

rick.oneill: pre-check: make sure us-west has compatible model variant and kv cache primed; otherwise we'll see cold-KV spikes. recommend warm-up after shift.

maya.patel: executing traffic shift:

```
trafficctl route update --route /v1/generate --region us-nw --set-weight 0.15
trafficctl route update --route /v1/generate --region us-west --set-weight 0.85
```

devops-bot: traffic-controller: Change accepted. Rolling to edge routers. Progress: 30% -> 60% -> 100%. :white_check_mark:

alex.chen: starting a small warmup job to populate KV cache in us-west (5k reqs with low concurrency).

support-lead: started inbound support queue triage; flagging customers with high error rates and adding standard incident notice. cc: @product-support.

maya.patel: scaling model-proxy us-nw from 8 -> 20 instances to relieve backlog (autoscaling hit anomaly). issuing command now.

```
kubectl scale deployment model-proxy -n prod --replicas=20 -l region=us-nw
```

alex.chen: after traffic shift and warmup, 5xx rate falling: 4.8% -> 1.1% in 8 minutes. latency 95th down by ~180ms.

ops-analytics: customer-impact numbers updated: total affected requests in last 30m = 1.1M, error budget burn ~0.7%. top affected tenants: tenant-omega, tenant-beta (APAC->US edge flows).

rick.oneill: we still see a small cluster of 502s from proxy-08 with a specific stacktrace — adding short-term connection-shed for that node.

alex.chen: cordoned proxy-08 and restarted. logs show socket exhaustion then restart.

maya.patel: good. continue monitoring. recommend keeping traffic steering in place until us-nw backpressure clears and KV cache hits stabilize.

devops-bot: routing-state: us-west=85%, us-nw=15% (stable). health checks green.

support-lead: posted customer advisory to status page: "Partial regional degradation in US-Northwest — requests may see 5xx or increased latency. Workaround: retries and regional endpoint us-west."

jamie.park: taking follow-up on-call for the rest of the incident window — will coordinate cleanup and postmortem. handing off from @maya.patel.

maya.patel: handoff acked to @jamie.park. notes: cause likely backend overload -> socket exhaustion on model-proxy; mitigation = traffic steering + scale + restart of unhealthy nodes. action items: longer-term autoscaler tuning, KV cache priming in failover path, add per-tenant QPS guardrails.

jamie.park: noted. I'll keep traffic steering for 30m then gradually shift back once us-nw metrics stable (5xx < 0.3% for 15m). opening incident ticket and assigning owners.

ops-analytics: post-shift metrics at 18:49 UTC: global 5xx = 0.12%, us-nw = 0.28%, us-west = 0.05%.

maya.patel: thanks team. moving to follow-up items and scheduling postmortem 1:30pm PST tomorrow. tagging @support-lead @rick.oneill @alex.chen for notes. :+1:

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: severity lowered to sev3. Will maintain monitoring for 2 hours.
